summary: Offer explicit, identity-bound recovery actions for browser-local messages and threads

replay.detail: Unknown attempts are never retried or checked through speculative status requests. Never-dispatched sends require explicit recipient and authorization revalidation; only explicit applied:none permits Retry as a freshly prepared child attempt.

schema.detail: Reuses the existing browser-local IndexedDB database and saved intent envelopes; no browser or server schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Recovery actions follow each persisted attempt's delivery state and original identity. Copy opens a separate composer without replacing an existing draft; a deliberate send creates an independent attempt and warns that the original may have arrived. Foreign-identity and damaged records remain discard-only.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action, configuration change or re-pairing is required.

recovery.detail: Unknown attempts offer Copy and confirmed Discard, explicitly not-applied attempts offer Retry and Discard, and pending attempts offer Revalidate and send and Discard. Unavailable storage shows a notice without actions. Cross-tab notifications trigger persisted re-reads only, never authority or automatic dispatch. No original-member correlated outcome-read API is available, so unknown delivery remains unknown.
